h1: Regulated, national-scale and unforgiving. That is where we work.
lede: Each sector is served by a focused Purview company led by people from that market. When a problem crosses domains, those teams become one delivery organisation with one accountable owner.

blocks.text: Engineering delivery designed around regulated, complex and mission-critical sectors.

items.title: Banking & Financial Services
items.body: Core banking integration, payments, wallets, trading platforms (Murex, Calypso, Finastra) and AI-driven operations for global banks and national-scale schemes.

items.title: Government & Public Sector
items.body: State data centres, sovereign cloud, citizen wallets and mission systems. Crown Commercial Service supplier in the UK.

items.title: Healthcare & Life Sciences
items.body: Clinical systems, telehealth, revenue cycle management and the manufacturing and compliance engineering around them.

items.title: Wireless & Telecommunications
items.body: Network engineering, 5G and ORAN, platform engineering and managed operations for carriers, OEMs and technology majors.

items.title: FMCG & Manufacturing
items.body: Industrial vision AI, supply chain platforms, fleet telematics and enterprise systems for plants and distribution networks.

items.title: Media & Entertainment
items.body: Content platforms, digital marketing engineering and audience analytics, delivered with Purview Digital and 2080.

items.title: Retail & Distribution
items.body: Footfall and crowd analytics, payments and loyalty, supply chain visibility and store systems.

items.title: Travel, Transportation & Facilities
items.body: Passenger and cargo platforms, AIoT safety, ANPR and traffic analytics for airports, operators and smart city programmes.
